From there, we can enter iteration of single characters, going from left to right to see if we find a repeat. For even more efficiency, we use a sliding window of consecutive characters, can-be-a-subpattern against a set of previously found subpattern of the same length. If found, we slide again left over its $N$ consecutive characters until left reaching initial position, or `N==1`, in which case we start again.
